verdict.rationale: Speechmatics is a speech-to-text and text-to-speech API platform, not an agent itself, so an official MCP server is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack never mentions one. Agent STT, the voice-agent builder, SDKs and the llms.txt file are adjacent features, not an MCP server an agent could connect to.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
